## 1️⃣  Strategic Vision  

| Element | What it Means | Why it Matters |
|---------|----------------|----------------|
| **Authentic, respectful storytelling** | Content that resonates with lived experience | Builds trust, avoids tokenism and backlash |
| **Local‑first creation** | Regional creative teams lead ideation | Captures nuance, reduces “one‑size‑fits‑all” risk |
| **Central governance** | Global brand consistency & risk control | Ensures alignment to corporate values, legal & PR safety |
| **Rapid, coordinated response** | 24 h/7‑day monitoring & escalation | Limits amplification of harmful narratives |

---

## 2️⃣  Core Pillars  

| Pillar | Purpose | Key Actions |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| **Cultural Intelligence Hub** | Live knowledge base covering religious texts, local customs, contemporary sensitivities | Quarterly “Cultural Pulse” reports, community‑led advisory panels, glossary of do‑not‑do phrases |
| **Creative Stewardship Council (CSC)** | Multi‑layered approval body | Regional CSC heads (Gulf, NAM/SA, SEA, APAC, EU), Global CSC final sign‑off, dedicated “Cultural Gatekeeper” per campaign |
| **Amplify‑Safety Net** | Social‑media monitoring & quick‑action playbook | Real‑time sentiment dashboards (RAG), pre‑approved crisis responses, “Escalation Playbook” for legal, PR, compliance |
| **Amplify‑Authorship** | Ensure brand voice evolves with local input | Co‑creation workshops with local NGOs, chefs, influencers, “Local Voice Checklist” in brief templates |

| Phase | Owner | Deliverables | Approval checkpoints |
|-------|-------|--------------|-----------------------|

| Script/Storyboard | Local creative lead | Storyboard, copy, visual mock‑ups | Cultural Gatekeeper & Legal review |
| Audio/Visual Production | Local production house | Rough cut, voice‑overs | Global CSC “Tech & Quality” sign‑off |

| Go‑Live | Global Launch Manager | Multi‑channel release (TV, digital, OOH) | Global CSC & CEO |
| Post‑Launch Review | Marketing Analytics | KPI report, sentiment trend, community feedback | CSC & Regional Lead |

| Step | Tactic | Outcome |

| 1. Unified Social‑Media Dashboard | Real‑time sentiment, volume, geography | Early warning of spikes |

| 3. “Playbook‑Ready” Rebuttals | Pre‑written, vetted responses for common trolls | Consistency, speed |
| 4. “Community Liaisons” | Local influencers, NGOs, community leaders | Immediate grassroots amplification or correction |
| 5. “Rapid‑Impact Response” (RIA) Team | 24 h dedicated PR/legal team, global‑regional splits | Containment within 12 h |

5. Sentiment normalizes within 6 h; KPI recovers.
